# JoyRide Logistics LLC

JoyRide Logistics LLC is a Truck Transportation company. JoyRide Logistics LLC is a logistics company that provides transportation and transportation services. They have a strategic inflection point in 2025 and have made significant year-over-year improvements in every major safety metric. They are America's first all-electric sleep. JoyRide Logistics LLC employs 66 people (+20.0% YoY, +11 people), founded in 2014. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, United States. Its workforce is distributed across Bosnia and Herzegovina and United States.

## About

JoyRide Logistics LLC was founded in 2014 in Chandler, Arizona with just one truck and a vision. This year, we are proud to celebrate our 10th anniversary, marking a decade of growth, resilience, and dedication. 

Today, our fleet has expanded to over 250 trucks and 250+ drivers, serving multiple states across the Southwest and beyond.

At JoyRide, we believe in putting people first. Our values are centered on customer satisfaction, delivering on-time service, and going the extra mile to get the job done. 

We are proud to foster an environment of equal opportunity, with 15% of our drivers being women, 40% African American, and a diverse workforce representing different ethnicities and backgrounds. 

Our team of 50+ dispatchers works around the clock to ensure drivers and clients receive full support.

Giving back is in our DNA. We are committed to supporting nonprofit organizations, funding scholarships, and contributing to communities in need, both locally and abroad.

At JoyRide Logistics, our drivers are the engine of our success, proving day in and day out that reliability, hard work, and dedication make all the difference.

YOU KNOW WHEN IT'S JOYRIDE!
